methods.label: Angles around the shared vertex
methods.explanation:
The useful point to track is \(D\), where both squares and the equilateral triangle meet. Each square contributes a right angle, so \(\angle ADC=90^\circ\) and \(\angle EDG=90^\circ\). The equilateral triangle contributes \(\angle CDE=60^\circ\).

In the supplied figure, these three adjacent sectors and \(\angle GDA\) fill one complete turn around \(D\). Therefore,
\[
\angle GDA=360^\circ-90^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ
=\boxed{120^\circ}.
\]
The answer is choice C.
